text:
Yes. What you should buy depends on your Model Y's year.

**2020 to early-2025 Model Y (no factory rear screen)**
- Plug-in rear displays are the usual choice. They're about 8.66" and work while driving. Most also control rear climate and seat heat.
- **TESERY 8.66"** is $359 and fits Model Y 2020 to 2025.03: https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla. It has CarPlay and was easy to install per its reviewers. Some of those reviews report lag and a child-lock bug, so expect aftermarket quality.
- **Teslahubs Rear Display Ultra** is the cheapest of the named brands at $269.99 (2019 to 2024 only), per the comparison at https://dealectric.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen.
- **Amazon** has many similar 8.66" units for roughly $210 to $330: https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+back+seat+screen. Ratings are mixed (about 3.2 to 3.9 stars on most), so check the fit for your exact year before ordering.

**2025 to 2026 refresh (Juniper)**
- Most trims already have Tesla's own 8" rear touchscreen, and the plug-in displays above don't fit.
- If you have a Standard trim without a rear screen, Hansshow's H86 is $399.99, per the comparison page above.
- For a cheap add-on on most years, a TESERY seat-back tablet mount is $19.99. It doesn't fit the Juniper Performance or Standard trims, so check your trim.

**If you want a big screen for parked movies (camping, charging stops)**
- The **Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema** screen is $119.99. It clips into the roof rim, doubles as a sunshade, and you supply a portable projector. It's for parked use only: https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y.
- Through Dealectric, code CJ10 takes it to about $108: https://dealectric.com/go/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-tesla-model-y.
- Projectors to pair with it:
  - The Aurzen ZIP is $199.99: https://dealectric.com/go/aurzen-zip-tri-fold-mini-projector.
  - The ZIP Pro (1080p) is $579.99 and ships from Oct 30: https://dealectric.com/go/aurzen-zip-pro-tri-fold-1080p-projector.
- It's made for the 2025 to 2026 car. On 2020 to 2024 cars it only works in roof mode, and the rear panel won't fully cover the window.

**My pick:** for kids on road trips in a 2020 to 2024 car, the TESERY 8.66" or the Teslahubs Ultra. For a 2025 to 2026 car, the $19.99 tablet mount first, then the Aurzen setup only if you want parked movie nights.

The Dealectric links are affiliate links, so the site gets paid if you buy through them. The prices come from that page and may change.

What year and trim is your Model Y? I can narrow it to one pick.
